g.text: Three genuinely distinct, elegant, non-bulbous typographic directions developed to replace the rejected heavy wordmark. The approved Luminary C symbol, dark navy background, and white/cyan palette are strictly preserved.

A bespoke enterprise wordmark engineered in direct dialogue with the Luminary C. Features 45° beveled terminal cuts mirroring the C symbol, an architectural capital T with chamfered undercuts, and an exquisitely proportioned micro-spark beacon tittle on 'i'. Both "Cogni" and "Tara" share exact cap-height, x-height, baseline, and stroke thickness, restoring visual equilibrium.
TERMINAL TREATMENT: 45° Radial Cuts mirroring Luminary C
CAP-HEIGHT & BASELINE: 100% Identical across Cogni & Tara
SCALABILITY: VectorCraft Native · Web & Mobile Ready
Direction A: Refined Futuristic (Sleek Neo-Grotesque Precision)

A modern, airy, intellectual interpretation inspired by high-end typography (Geist Sans / Inter Display). Features clean vertical terminal shears on C, an understated square-cut tittle on 'i', and slightly extended optical tracking. Delivers a featherlight, highly sophisticated software aesthetic.
TITTLE ON 'i': Minimal Square Offset (Pixel Precision)
Direction B: Premium Geometric (Architectural Modernist Purity)

A disciplined geometric sans inspired by modernist icons (Futura / General Sans / Sharp Grotesk). Features generous circular bowls, wide open apertures, a stable broad crossbar on T, and a perfectly centered circular tittle. Substantial, confident, and timeless without becoming thick or cartoonish.
TERMINAL TREATMENT: Horizontal Cuts · Open Apertures
TITTLE ON 'i': Optically Centered Circular Dot
COGNITARA BRAND IDENTITY · TYPOGRAPHIC AUDIT & EVALUATION SHEET
